title: Recording: Little Woman Love by Wings | 1971
content:
Studio B, Sound Recorders Studio, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eirik Wangberg

Paul McCartney finished recording the future Wings song ‘Little Woman Love’ on 23 March 1971. The overdubs included lead guitar.

Although this was one of the Ram recording sessions, the song was released as the b-side of Wings’ second single ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’.
